description: An operations director must decide whether to authorize a weekend coating campaign in a shared paint booth and finalize the maintenance, emissions-testing, and staffing controls, with input from a maintenance lead and an environmental compliance specialist.

shared_context.S1: The plant has a backlog of coated brackets, and the shared paint booth is available for a proposed weekend campaign.
shared_context.S2: The operations director has authority to authorize the campaign and set its operating controls.
shared_context.S3: The booth normally runs weekday campaigns, and weekend work requires a documented operating plan before the first shift begins.
shared_context.S4: Plant policy requires maintenance and environmental compliance sign-off on every weekend paint-booth operating plan before the first shift begins.
shared_context.S5: The current staffing roster shows that two certified coating operators are assigned and available for the proposed weekend campaign.
shared_context.S6: As part of the standard planning meeting, the maintenance lead and environmental compliance specialist each present their current inspection or review finding using the plant's formal issue-recording step before the operating director settles the plan.

PF1.text: Jon's inspection this morning measured the booth exhaust filter differential pressure at 2.4 kPa, above the 1.5 kPa maintenance limit; the replacement filter is in stores and takes exactly 4 hours to install, but he has not entered the reading in the maintenance system yet.

PF2.text: Priya's permit review confirmed that this booth may operate for exactly 16 hours during the weekend campaign, but only after a VOC capture test records at least 95 percent capture and two currently certified coating operators are assigned; she completed the review yesterday but the updated permit note has not yet been attached to the campaign file.

acceptance_conditions: The campaign must be authorized only subject to completion of the required maintenance and environmental prerequisites.
The campaign must be limited to exactly 16 operating hours.
The exhaust filter must be replaced before the campaign with exactly 4 hours of maintenance downtime.
A VOC capture test must record at least 95 percent capture before operation.
Exactly two certified coating operators must be assigned.
The maintenance replacement must be recorded as a maintenance commitment.
The VOC capture test and permit requirements must be recorded as an environmental compliance commitment.
The permit review finding must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C6: any((c['type'] == 'maintenance' or c['type'] == 'maintenance_action' or c['type'] == 'maintenance_sign_off') and c['target'] == 'Jon' for c in commitments) and decisions['maintenance_downtime_hours'] == 4
content_checks.C7: any((c['type'] == 'environmental_compliance' or c['type'] == 'environmental_action' or c['type'] == 'environmental_compliance_sign_off' or c['type'] == 'sign_off') and c['target'] == 'Priya' for c in commitments) and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids

decisive_facts.why: The 2.4 kPa reading above the 1.5 kPa limit changes the plan from ordinary operation to filter replacement before the campaign with exactly 4 hours of maintenance downtime and a maintenance commitment assigned to Jon.

The permit review changes the campaign to a conditional authorization capped at exactly 16 hours, requires at least 95 percent VOC capture and exactly two certified operators, and requires an environmental compliance commitment citing the permit finding.
